rationale.org-governance: Maps organizational AI risks, policy gaps, and continuous reassessment needs.
rationale.rules-based-checks: Practitioners report testing tools flagging security issues before code integration.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Interviews document AI-generated code triggering potential security warnings.
rationale.quality-debt: Organizations report poor-quality outputs and failures on complex domain tasks.
rationale.survey-input: Longitudinal findings identify organizational risk priorities suitable for survey items.
rationale.assistive: Developers use Copilot and ChatGPT interactively for coding assistance.
rationale.risk-security: Security harms include insecure code and source-code leakage concerns.
rationale.risk-quality: Empirical findings cover poor output quality and task inadequacy.
rationale.risk-ip: Practitioners report licensing and copied-design concerns in generated outputs.
rationale.method-self-report: Developers and managers supplied evidence through semi-structured interviews and workshops.
rationale.method-field-study: Longitudinal multi-case study followed natural organizational adoption for one year.
